Command replay (a class of call, not one reported incident)

Stop an agent trying to remove a Vercel project

What happens

Vercel project removal. The call below tries to remove a Vercel project. The agent sends it through its Bash tool, and it involves Vercel.

The call

vercel remove my-prod-app --yes

Tool: Bash. The replay uses placeholder tokens and hosts only.

Fix it without us

Use a Vercel access token for the one team the agent works in, and not a token for your whole account. Keep the code in Git and a copy of the project settings and environment variables outside Vercel, so a removed project can be set up again.

What KYA does

Replay result: Stopped. In the replay test, the local hook denies the call and names the rule.

Rule vercel-remove, first stopped in version 0.35.0.

The hook is local and advisory. It fails open: if kya breaks or times out, the call goes ahead.

Install

For Claude Code, the host this replay ran on:

/plugin marketplace add The-Pixel-Boys/shield-kya
/plugin install kya@shield-kya

For any host:

npm i -g @shield-agent/kya@latest && kya start
